title.zh: SmartLingo 菜单按钮与品牌字样布局修复
title.en: SmartLingo menu button and wordmark layout fix

purpose.zh: 使汉堡菜单按钮沿用 Konectible 已验证的外观，并修复 iPad 横屏下品牌字样被强制拆成两行的问题。
purpose.en: Reuse Konectible's verified hamburger-button appearance and stop the wordmark from being forced onto two lines in iPad landscape.

zh: 汉堡按钮改为 Konectible 的白底蓝色线条与浅蓝色悬停、展开状态；保留 SmartLingo 的菜单内容与账户导航。
移除 1101–1320px 范围内强制将 Smart 与 Lingo 排成两行的旧规则。
en: Match Konectible's white hamburger button, blue strokes, and pale-blue hover and expanded states while preserving SmartLingo's menu and account links.
Remove the old 1101–1320px rule that forced Smart and Lingo onto separate lines.

zh: 全站共用导航栏及首页品牌字样；不改变学习、会员或支付功能。
en: Shared site header and homepage wordmark; learning, membership, and payments are unchanged.

zh: 仅复用 Konectible 按钮样式并删除旧换行规则；扩展真实 WebKit 布局检查，确认 Smart 与 Lingo 保持同一行。
en: Reuse Konectible's button styles, remove the obsolete wrap rule, and extend the real WebKit layout gate to confirm Smart and Lingo stay on one line.

zh: 共享站点基线检查、476 项测试、TypeScript、零警告 lint、构建与敏感信息扫描通过；完成 WebKit 布局及生产浏览器核验。
en: Shared-site baseline checks, 476 tests, TypeScript, zero-warning lint, build, and sensitive-data scan passed; complete WebKit layout and production-browser verification.

zh: 此发布不涉及登录、课程或支付流程；这些流程未因本次视觉改动重新演练。
en: This visual-only release does not change sign-in, course, or payment flows; those flows are not re-exercised for this change.

zh: 沿用 Konectible 已验证的按钮颜色与交互状态，保留 SmartLingo 独立品牌字样、语言选项和账户菜单。
en: Carry over Konectible's reviewed button colors and interaction states while retaining SmartLingo's own wordmark, language choices, and account menu.

rollback.zh: 无需数据回退；如需撤销视觉调整，可重新部署上一成功提交。
rollback.en: No data rollback is needed; redeploy the previous successful commit to revert the visual adjustment.
